spans.s:
मे मे, cl. 1. A. मयते, ममे, मास्यते,
अमास्त, मातुम्, to change, exchange, barter:
Caus. मापयति, -यितुम्, to cross over, (perhaps fr.
rt. 3. मा): Desid. मित्सते: Intens. मेमीयते,
मामेति, मामाति; [cf. Gr. ἀ-μείβ-ω, ἀμείβ-ο-μαι,
ἀ-μεύ-σα-οθαι, παρ-αμείβ-εινμ ἀμοιβή, μοῖ-το-ς:
Lat. me-a-re, mov-e-o, mô-tu-s, mô-tio, mô-men-
tu-m, mu-ta-re, mû-tuu-s, communis, munus:
Goth. maithms, maidjan, ga-mains: Angl. Sax.
[]
madhm, mane, man, ge-mœne: Slav. me-na,
‘change:’ Lith. mai-na-s, ‘exchange;’ mainý-ti,
‘to change, exchange.’]
